title: batch.reconcile
description: Structured, rule-based evidence-completeness and conflict check for a batch, over evidence already retrieved and gated. Produces the candidate finding set the Batch-Review Agent is allowed to synthesize prose from — it does not itself synthesize. Deterministic given the same evidence set.
authorization_requirement: Caller must present a batch_review graph-run credential. No PV or Supply run may hold this credential (ADR-008).

idempotency.guarantee: Deterministic given the same evidence_ids and policy_contract_version.

evidence_ids.description: Must be a subset of evidence_ids returned by evidence.retrieve (batch scope) in this run. The tool rejects any id it cannot trace to this run's retrieval.

reconciliation_complete.description: Whether every required evidence category (genealogy, lab results, environmental monitoring, deviations, CAPA, change control, validation state, supplier evidence) has at least one citable item.

findings.description: Structured findings only. No field here or anywhere in this schema represents a disposition — see 'What this schema cannot express' below.

status.description: Structural completeness/conflict status of the evidence in this category. Never a judgment about whether the batch is releasable.

gap_description.description: Present only when status is 'gap' or 'conflict'. Factual description of what evidence is missing or in conflict — never a recommendation for what to do about it.

what_this_schema_cannot_express: Any of these fields would make this tool capable of what DDD domain_model.md §7 requires the Batch aggregate itself to be incapable of representing. This tool's output type is a second, independent enforcement of the same invariant (ADR-004 layer 1 + layer 2).

errors.meaning: An evidence_id was not returned by this run's own retrieval call.
errors.graph_response: abstain — treat as a gate defect, do not silently drop the id
